content_zh:
第17章凝气惊天地
“他在凝气开脉！”
一直表情淡然的崔图此时露出惊惧之色，
“不可让他凝气成功！”
崔图心中暗道，
原以为只是一个区区铸体期武者，
没想到竟然如此棘手，
茶楼中的林寒，
此时原本嘲弄的表情也变为凝重，
因为江尘所展示出的实力，
已经远远超过了他的预期，
哪怕是他，
同为铸体时，
也未必是这江尘的对手，
他的眼中杀意隐现，
这种人，
万万不可让他成长起来，
不然必为日后大敌！
江尘此时却浑然不觉，
沉浸在一招一式当中，

每一枪击出，
都感觉自己血脉的震动，
每一招使出，
都能体会到真元在经脉中澎湃涌动！
凝气开脉，
乃是武道中的最重要一步，
所谓凝气，
便是凝气破脉，打通体内八大经脉，
由凡人身躯向武者身躯发生转变，
凝气后，无论是力量速度，甚至是抗击打能力，都会有大幅度提升，而打通体内经脉的数量，也是决定日后武道高度的关键，
寻常人能开三脉已是不易，比如江尘的父亲江烈，就是开了三脉，只有大派弟子才有机会开到四脉，
至于更多的，那就是各派天骄，他们会是日后的掌教人选，或是一方人皇，他们所学功法，个人天赋无一不是世间顶流，
而在战斗中开脉，却是闻所未闻，见所未见！
“他开第一脉了！”
周围众人的目光，全部聚集在江尘上方，在那里，一道白色气旋涌现，正是开一脉的象征，很快，第二道气旋也在逐渐形成，
对于一幕，凝气期的众人都不陌生，因为他们在凝气的时候，也会出现这种情形，此为气冲八脉，以脉确定日后成就，
“他开了第二脉，第三脉还在形成！”
江尘气息随着经脉的打通愈发浑厚凝实，
content_en:
Chapter 17 Condensing Qi to Shock the Heaven and Earth
"He's condensing energy and opening his pulse!"
Cui Tu, who had always had a calm expression, now looked frightened.
"Don't let him succeed in condensing energy!"
Cui Tu secretly thought,
I originally thought he was just a warrior in the casting stage.
I didn't expect it to be so difficult.
Lin Han in the teahouse,
At this time, the originally mocking expression turned into a solemn one.
Because of the strength Jiang Chen showed,
It has far exceeded his expectations,
Even if it's him,
When they are both cast bodies,
He may not be Jiang Chen’s opponent.
There was murderous intent in his eyes,
This kind of person,
Never let him grow up,
Otherwise, you will become your enemy in the future!
Jiang Chen was completely unaware at this time.
Immersed in every move,
Every shot fired,
They all feel the vibration of their own blood,
Every move is used,
Everyone can feel the true energy surging in the meridians!
Condensing Qi and opening pulse,
It is the most important step in martial arts.
The so-called condensation of Qi,
It is to condense Qi and break the meridians, opening up the eight major meridians in the body.
Transformation from a mortal body to a warrior body,
After condensing Qi, both strength, speed, and even resistance to blows will be greatly improved. The number of meridians opened in the body is also the key to determining the height of martial arts in the future.
It is not easy for ordinary people to open the three meridians. For example, Jiang Chen's father, Jiang Lie, has opened the third meridians. Only disciples of the great sect have the opportunity to open the fourth meridians.
As for more, they are the geniuses of various sects. They will be the candidates to be the leader in the future, or the emperor of one party. The techniques they have learned and their personal talents are all top-notch in the world.
But opening one's pulse during battle is unheard of and unseen!
"He opened his first pulse!"
The eyes of everyone around him were all focused on Jiang Chen, where a white cyclone emerged, which was the symbol of opening a vein. Soon, a second cyclone gradually formed.
Everyone in the Qi Condensation stage is familiar with this scene, because they will also experience this situation when they are condensing Qi. This is the Qi rushing through the eight meridians, and the pulses are used to determine future achievements.
"He opened the second meridian, and the third meridian is still forming!"
Jiang Chen's aura became thicker and thicker as his meridians opened up.
